title: Elasticsearch connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Elasticsearch connector instance's settings, read by the native search family (`loams_connector_search::elasticsearch`, CN2 Task 15, OR-8): the cluster URL, the index, the `_bulk` sink's batching and the point-in-time source's cursor. It covers the source and the sink. `basic.password` and `api_key` hold the **names** of secrets in the namespace's store (D189), which the connector resolves when it connects; they are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list. The `key` property is declared because the manifest declares capabilities.sink.upsert: true (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule); it is the document _id the upsert and the delete use, and without it _id is the event's ce_id.

url.description: The cluster base URL, http:// or https://, with no credentials in it. A Loams collection's ES gateway endpoint works unchanged (§33 §8 row 11), as an extra target (OR-2).

index.description: The index (or alias) read or written.

api.description: The point-in-time API the cluster speaks. An OpenSearch target profile sets `opensearch` in its defaults.

basic.description: HTTP basic auth (the manifest's `basic` auth slug).

password.description: The name of the secret holding the basic-auth password, resolved through the secret store (D189).

api_key.description: The name of the secret holding an API key (the base64 of id:api_key, sent as `Authorization: ApiKey …`), resolved through the secret store (D189).

key.description: The document key: a JSON pointer (or a top-level field name) into an event's data whose value becomes the _id. Without it, _id is the event's ce_id. Either way a replay overwrites rather than duplicates (effectively once).

apply_deletes.description: Apply events carrying loamsop = d as a delete by _id.

bulk.description: The `_bulk` sink. A partial failure resends only the failed items; a 429 halves the documents per request.

max_item_retries.description: Retries of the failed items of one write before it fails.

retry_backoff_ms.description: The first backoff between item retries, doubled each time (30 s at most).

source.description: The point-in-time source: `search_after` with a tiebreaker, incremental by a cursor field.

cursor_field.description: A field that only grows (an update time, a sequence): reads are ordered by it and a new pass starts at its last value read. Without it every pass reads the whole index.

tiebreaker.description: The sort tiebreaker inside a point in time: `_shard_doc` on Elasticsearch, `_id` on OpenSearch by default.

keep_alive.description: How long a point in time stays open between pages, as a duration string.

poll_interval_ms.description: With it, a pass that reached the end starts again this long after; without it the source reads one pass and ends.

query.description: A Query DSL query the read is filtered by.
